# Manifest

> Manifest is the skydive app for iPhone (the app for skydivers) and the system for dropzones. The iPhone app shows live loads from 150+ dropzones, used by jumpers in 38 countries, records a jump from your pocket and replays the whole flight in 3D over real terrain, and covers weather, gear reminders, a logbook with in-person sign-offs, dropzones and community. Manifest Desk is browser-based manifest software for dropzones, connected live to the app. The app is free to download. Made by Manifest Jump LLC (Wyoming, USA).

## Why Manifest is different: one connected loop
Most dropzone software only runs the desk, and most skydiving apps only record jumps. Manifest connects the whole jump day in one live system:
1. The jumper already carries the Manifest app (live loads, 3D replays) and manifests themselves onto a load from their phone.
2. The dropzone sees it instantly on Manifest Desk and stays in control: staff move people between loads, run standby and approve every slot.
3. Payments land in the dropzone's own Stripe account (Apple Pay top-ups), so Manifest never holds the dropzone's money.
4. Load calls (called, gear-up at 15 minutes, 10 minutes, 5 minutes, boarding, holds) reach every jumper on the load on their Lock Screen the moment staff press the button.
5. Safety stays shared: the desk sees who is on which load, who is back after the jump, and any landout on a live map.

## How landout location sharing works
- Manifest does not track jumpers for the dropzone during the jump. Location is shared with the desk only when the jumper asks for help.
- After landing, the jumper taps "Landed out?" (in the app or from the Lock Screen) and picks how they are: injured, need a ride, or walking back.
- The phone sends its GPS position, and keeps updating it while the help call is open, so staff see a live dot on a satellite map with the distance from the dropzone.
- The desk can send a pickup pin to a driver, show the jumper who is coming and their ETA, call the jumper, and put every load on hold with one tap. The emergency contact is shown only when the jumper is injured.
- Sharing stops when the call is resolved or the jumper taps "I'm back". It supports the dropzone's own emergency procedures; it is not a guaranteed rescue tracker, since it depends on the phone's battery, GPS and signal.

## Who it is for
- Skydivers (fun jumpers): anyone who jumps at a dropzone and wants live loads, 3D replays of their jumps and their jump records on their phone.
- Dropzone owners and manifest staff: Manifest Desk runs loads, money, staff and safety, and puts every load call on every jumper's phone.

## What the app does (iPhone, free to download)
- Live loads: the loads turning right now at 220+ dropzones in 38 countries, who is on them and the minutes to call, read from each dropzone's own manifest.
- 3D jump replay (free): record a jump with the phone in your pocket and replay the whole flight in 3D over real terrain, from the climb to the landing, using the phone's GPS and barometer. No extra hardware.
- Logbook with sign-offs: another licensed jumper who was there scans your QR and signs the jump off in person; their name and licence number go on the entry. Records the fields USPA SIM 3-1 requires. Import past jumps from CSV.
- Check-in Pass and Apple Wallet pass: licence, currency, jump numbers and gear service in one scannable view.
- Weather and winds for jumping, gear and reserve repack reminders, dropzone finder, events, coaches, messaging and community.
- Works offline: log with no signal, it syncs later.

## Manifest Pro (optional, paid in the app)
- Your load on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with gear-up and final-call notifications. Free at Manifest Desk dropzones.
- A recorder that arms itself when your load takes off, cloud backup of tracks, replay stats, jump receipt, track and PDF exports.
- Yearly subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase.

## Manifest Desk: skydiving software for dropzones
Manifest Desk is skydiving software and dropzone management software (a skydive manifest system) that runs in any browser at https://desk.jumpmanifest.com, connected live to the Manifest app jumpers carry. Details: https://www.jumpmanifest.com/skydiving-manifest-software/
- Loads board with exit order, reserved seats, teams, required crew and double-manifest rules.
- Standby by jumper type, with teams kept together; jumpers can self-manifest and join standby from the app.
- Load calls pushed to every jumper's phone and Lock Screen at 15, 10 and 5 minutes and boarding, plus holds for one load or all loads.
- Weight and balance against the aircraft.
- Jumper accounts and balances, jump tickets, vouchers and gift vouchers.
- Apple Pay and card top-ups through Stripe Connect, straight into the dropzone's own Stripe account; guest payments, card on file and receipts.
- Cash drawer and end of day.
- Waivers and check-in rules per licence type; safety checks for currency, reserve repack and AAD service.
- Staff pay per jump type; roles for Owner, Manifest and Crew.
- Aircraft fuel, hours and maintenance, and a pilot view.
- Reports: day log, liabilities (credit held, tickets and vouchers outstanding) and accounting export.
- CSV import of jumpers and balances from the dropzone's current system.
- Rental gear.
- Landout SOS with a live map and chat, a pickup pin for the driver, and Who's back after each load.
- Hangar TV board on any TV with a browser.
- Prices: Weekend dropzone $249/month, Full-time $399/month, Big operations from $699/month. No fee per jump or per booking, no lock-in.

## Pricing (Manifest Desk)
- Weekend dropzone: $249/month (1 aircraft, 3 desk logins, 2% on in-app top-ups only).
- Full-time dropzone: $399/month (up to 3 aircraft, 10 desk logins, staff pay and payroll export, 1.5% on in-app top-ups only).
- Big operations: from $699/month (unlimited aircraft and logins, several dropzones on one login, 1% on in-app top-ups only).
- Pay yearly and get two months free. No lock-in, cancel anytime. The first 10 founding dropzones get 30% off year one.
- No fee on cash or card payments taken at the desk.

The Manifest app shows skydiving weather for any dropzone: wind at exit altitude, under canopy and on the ground with gusts, the winds aloft profile, cloud, rain, the calmest window and sunset. It is a forecast, not a jumpable verdict; the dropzone decides whether loads fly. Weather is free.

## How 3D jump replay works
- The phone records a sample about once a second, each one a position, an altitude and a moment in time, from climb-out until you are standing in the landing area.
- GPS gives the position and the phone's barometer gives the altitude. The phases (climb, exit, freefall, opening, canopy) come out of the data rather than being typed in.
- The replay draws the track as a line over real terrain and flies a camera along it. More: https://www.jumpmanifest.com/skydive-3d-tracking/

## Logbook and USPA
- USPA SIM 3-1 allows digital logbooks if each jump records jump number, date, location, exit altitude, freefall time, type of jump, landing distance from the target, equipment used and a verifying signature with an identifying number.
- Manifest records those fields, sign-off is in person by another licensed jumper whose licence number goes on the entry, and a signed entry locks. Manifest is on USPA's jump log apps page (https://www.uspa.org/logbookapps). More: https://www.jumpmanifest.com/uspa-digital-logbook/

## FAQ: the Manifest app

### What does the Manifest skydiving app do?
Manifest is the app for skydivers, on iPhone. It shows the loads turning live at 150+ dropzones, records your jump from your pocket and replays the whole flight in 3D over real terrain, and keeps your logbook with jumps signed off in person by licensed jumpers. It also has weather and winds for jumping, gear and reserve repack reminders, your Check-in Pass, dropzones, events, coaches and community.

### Is Manifest free?
Manifest is free to download, with no limit on how many jumps you log. Logging, getting jumps signed off, your Check-in Pass, live loads, gear service reminders, dropzones, events and community are all free, and so is recording a jump and watching it replayed in 3D. Manifest Pro adds your load on your Lock Screen with gear-up and final-call notifications and a live countdown in your Dynamic Island, a recorder that arms itself when your load takes off, cloud backup of your tracks, replay stats, your jump receipt, raw track exports for ParaLog or Google Earth, branded PDF exports of your logbook and gear, and your credentials on your Check-in Pass. At Manifest Desk dropzones the Lock Screen card is free. Pro is a yearly subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase.

### Can I replay my skydive in 3D?
Yes, and it is free. Record your jump with your phone in your pocket and Manifest replays the whole flight in 3D over real terrain, from the climb to the landing, using the phone's own GPS and barometer. No extra hardware is needed.

### Can I bring my existing jumps across?
Yes. You can import your whole history from a CSV, whether it comes from another app or your own spreadsheet. Tunnel time and reserve repacks can be imported too.

### How does a jump get verified?
Another licensed jumper who was there scans your QR and signs it off. Their name and licence number are recorded on that jump, so it is witnessed rather than self-reported. Your logbook shows your total jumps and your verified jumps side by side.

### Does it work at my dropzone?
Logging, verification, your pass and your gear work anywhere in the world. Live loads currently work at 150+ dropzones, and we are adding more. If yours is not covered yet, everything else still works normally.

### Which dropzones does Manifest show live loads for?
Manifest shows live loads from 150+ dropzones, used by jumpers in 38 countries: what's on call, who's on it and the minutes to call, straight off each dropzone's own manifest. At dropzones that run Manifest Desk, every load call also goes straight to your Lock Screen.

### Does it work without signal?
Yes. You can log jumps with no signal at all and they sync as soon as you are back online, which matters on a dropzone with bad wifi.

### Is Manifest listed by USPA?
Yes. Manifest is on the United States Parachute Association's jump log apps page, which lists the digital logbooks that meet USPA's criteria. Every jump records the fields USPA SIM 3-1 requires, and sign-off is in person by another licensed jumper whose licence number goes on the entry.

### Will a dropzone accept it?
Your Check-in Pass shows your licence, currency, jump numbers and gear service in one scannable view, pulled straight from your record so it cannot be edited by hand. The person scanning it does not need the app. Pro also gives you a branded PDF of every signed-off jump.

### Is my data private?
Your logbook, credentials and documents are yours and are access-controlled. You choose what is public on your profile, you can go fully private, and you can delete your account and its data from inside the app at any time.

### What is Manifest Desk?
Manifest Desk is skydiving software for dropzones, running in the browser. It handles loads and exit order, standby, jumper accounts and payments, waivers, staff, aircraft, safety checks and a hangar TV board, and pushes every load call to jumpers' Lock Screens. Jumpers top up with Apple Pay, straight into the dropzone's own Stripe account. Plans start at $249 a month with no lock-in. See Manifest Desk or read what our dropzone software does.

### Is Android coming?
Yes. Android is being built right now. Email me and I will let you know the day it is out.

## FAQ: what dropzone software should do

### What is dropzone software?
Dropzone software, also called skydiving manifest software or a skydive manifest system, is what a dropzone uses to build loads, put jumpers on them, charge their accounts and keep the jump day safe and moving. Manifest Desk does all of that in a browser, and connects every load to the phones of the jumpers on it.

### What should skydiving software for a dropzone do?
At minimum: a loads board with exit order, standby, jumper accounts and balances, load calls and holds, weight and balance against the aircraft, and safety checks for currency, reserve and AAD before anyone boards. A complete system also handles waivers and check-in rules, staff pay, aircraft hours and maintenance, guest payments, the cash drawer and end of day, and reports for your accountant. Manifest Desk does all of these, and puts every load call on each jumper's Lock Screen.

### How much does Manifest Desk cost?
A flat monthly price per plan, never a fee per jump or per booking. Weekend dropzone is $249 a month (1 aircraft, 3 desk logins), Full-time is $399 a month (up to 3 aircraft, 10 logins) and Big operations starts at $699 a month (unlimited). The only other fee is on top-ups jumpers make in the app: 2%, 1.5% or 1% depending on the plan. Cash and card taken at the desk carry no fee from us. Pay yearly and get two months free, and cancel anytime.

### How do we switch from our current system?
We set up your dropzone with you: aircraft, jump prices, staff and jumpers. You can run Manifest Desk next to your current system for as long as you like, until you trust it, and we are with you on your first jump day. There is no lock-in.

### Can we import our jumpers and balances?
Yes. Export your jumper list and balances from your current system as a CSV and the desk imports it, so every jumper starts with the right account. We do this for you during setup.

### How do payments work?
Jumpers top up their account in the Manifest app with Apple Pay or card, and the money goes straight to your own Stripe account through Stripe Connect, so you are the merchant. At the desk you can take guest payments, charge a card on file, sell tickets, vouchers and gift vouchers, and count the cash drawer at end of day. Every payment gets a receipt.

### Does it work for a small club or weekend dropzone?
Yes. The Weekend dropzone plan is built for one aircraft and busy weekends, with 3 desk logins and crew free. All you need is a laptop or tablet with a browser for the desk, and any TV with a browser for the hangar board. There is nothing to install.

### What safety features does it have?
Before anyone boards, the desk checks currency, reserve repack and AAD service, and your waiver and check-in rules per licence type. Each load shows its weight against the aircraft, the crew it needs and double-manifest conflicts. After the load, Who's back shows who has returned, and a jumper who lands out can send an SOS that puts them on a live map at the desk, with chat and one tap to hold every load. It supports your own emergency procedures; it is not a guaranteed rescue tracker.

## FAQ: Manifest Desk for dropzones

### Is it easy to switch from our current system?
Yes. We move your jumpers and prices over for you, and you can run both side by side for as long as you like, until you trust it.

### Who moves our jumpers and balances?
We do, during setup. Export your jumpers and balances from your current system as a CSV and the desk imports them, so every account starts with the right balance.

### Is there a contract?
A simple service agreement, with no lock-in. Cancel anytime, on any plan, including the founding deal. Paying yearly saves two months.

### What hardware do we need?
Any laptop or tablet with a browser runs the desk. Any TV with a browser shows the hangar board.

### Do jumpers pay for the app?
No. The Manifest app is free to download. At your dropzone, jumpers book, top up and get load calls in it.

### When are we charged?
Nothing until your desk goes live. The first 10 dropzones get 30% off their first year.

### Do you take a fee on payments at our desk?
No. Cash, your card terminal and anything you take at the desk is yours, with no fee from us. The fee is only on top-ups jumpers make themselves in the Manifest app.

### Who owns the data?
You do. Export it any time on Full-time and up.

## FAQ: support

### How do I log a jump, and does it work without signal?
Tap the log button on your logbook, fill in the details, and save. Logging works fully offline: a jump you save in airplane mode is stored on your device and syncs automatically the next time you have a connection.

### What is the Check-in Pass?
It’s a live, scannable QR that opens a web page showing your licence type, currency, jump numbers and gear service status, pulled straight from Manifest so it can’t be edited or faked. Whoever scans it needs no app.

### How does jump sign-off and verification work?
Another licensed jumper can sign off your jumps; their name and licence are recorded on each one. Your profile shows your total jumps and your independently verified jumps side by side. Sign-offs are frozen once made.

### How do gear service reminders work?
Add your rig, canopy, reserve and AAD with their service dates, and Manifest reminds you before your reserve repack and AAD service fall due. You set the dates; Manifest never overrides them with assumptions.

### What does Manifest Pro include?
Pro is the Lock Screen. Your load appears there the moment it is called, with gear-up and final-call notifications and a live countdown in the Dynamic Island, so the plane does not leave without you. At Manifest Desk dropzones the Lock Screen card is free. It also adds cloud backup of your tracks, replay stats, your jump receipt, your credentials on your Check-in Pass, and branded PDF exports of your logbook and gear passport. It’s a yearly subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Logging, currency, sign-offs, live loads, dropzones, events and community stay free.

### How do I manage or cancel my subscription?
Subscriptions are billed through your Apple ID, so you manage them in iOS: Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions → Manifest, where you can change plan or cancel. Cancelling stops the next renewal; you keep Pro until the current period ends.

### How do I delete my account?
In the app, go to Profile → Settings (gear) → Delete account. This permanently erases your profile, logbook, gear, listings and events via an automated cascade. It can’t be undone. See our Privacy Policy for what is retained.

### How do I report or block someone?
Open the person’s profile or a conversation and use Report or Block. Reports are reviewed, and content is removed or accounts suspended where they break the Terms. To report something urgently, email andre@manifestjump.com.

### How do I get the blue verification check?
Verification is free. Upload a credential in your in-app credentials wallet and apply. An authorised admin reviews it. Verification reflects account status; it is not a guarantee of anyone’s skill or certification.
